patch_description: Since the exact forward/backward-pass body could not be located verbatim in the editable region, this edit takes the safer route of adding a self-contained Rauch-Tung-Striebel (RTS) smoother variant as a new function within the editable region, and wiring the main entry point's delegation call to use it (falling back to the existing implementation for degenerate inputs). The new function implements a constant-velocity Kalman forward pass over each sliding window, stores filtered states/covariances and predicted covariances, then runs the exact backward RTS recursion with gain G = P_f F' P_pred^{-1}. This is the minimum-variance fixed-interval estimate and avoids the information double-counting of an independent backward-filter blend, improving noise rejection and reducing false slope reversals at the same O(n) cost. The output length is explicitly validated as n - window_size + 1, guarding against the total-failure class of bugs seen in earlier generations.
